name: Maritza Cruz
office: City of Maywood, Member of the City Council

items.text: Maritza Cruz is a Maywood planning commissioner. She participates in community programs and volunteer opportunities, and believes service and civic engagement build strong communities. She says she will be transparent and work with colleagues to find solutions that improve quality of life.
